# Migration Readiness Checklist: Electrobun v2 Upgrade

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for the v1→v2 shell migration — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage of recovery/edge scenarios.
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all v1 config fields that must migrate or be removed explicitly enumerated? [Gap, contracts/config.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the mandatory `hutch.config.ts` script entries (install, dev, build, build:stable) completely specified? [Completeness, contracts/config.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement covering the import specifier migration (`electrobun` → `electrobun/main`)? [Completeness, contracts/config.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for generated artifacts' commit policy (`.hutch/devkit` ignored vs `hutch.lock` committed)? [Completeness, contracts/config.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Is behavior specified for a fresh checkout without `.hutch/devkit` (first-run prepare contract)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is there a requirement keeping `package.json` scripts consistent with `hutch` tasks (no duplicate/conflicting entrypoints)? [Gap, contracts/config.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "latest stable at migration time" replaced by a concrete version-resolution mechanism? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "resolvable at runtime" for native libs quantified with a concrete bundle path contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "identical behavior" for regression defined by an explicit scenario comparison set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the dev-server URL/port contract specified (hardcoded `localhost:5173` vs configurable)? [Ambiguity, tasks.md T010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do version-pin requirements agree between `package.json` (`electrobun@^2`) and `hutch.config.ts` (`electrobun.version`)? [Consistency, contracts/config.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Are dev-mode and packaged-mode renderer-loading requirements consistent (`vite dev-server` vs `views://`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Do ASAR/unpack requirements conflict with `dlopen` real-file needs under any default packaging behavior? [Conflict, research.md D6]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Is SC-001 (<15s dev launch) measurable given first-run toolchain download — is cold start exempted? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-002's "100% of prior scenarios" objectively enumerable (explicit link to feature-001 acceptance scenarios)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Is SC-004's "zero stale configs" mechanically checkable (defined file/field list)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are recovery/rollback requirements defined if the migration leaves a broken toolchain state? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements specified for first-run with limited/no network (paired-toolchain download fails)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for mid-migration partial state (new config + stale lockfile/cache)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is per-OS coverage explicitly bounded (host-only now, other OSes deferred to CI)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for native staging while `native/out/` is empty (feature-001 native build pending)? [Coverage, tasks.md T014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are first-run toolchain download size/time expectations bounded or documented? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are reproducible-build requirements specified (exact pins vs floating ranges for toolchain + deps)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption "`bun:ffi` semantics unchanged in packaged Bun 1.4.x" backed by a verification requirement? [Assumption, research.md D7]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the devkit-types-replaces-shim assumption conditionalized with an explicit fallback requirement? [Assumption, research.md D5, tasks.md T009]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the external dependency on Electrobun GitHub Release availability documented? [Dependency, research.md D1]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Is "community best practices" concretized beyond the config schema (enumerated convention list)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the task boundary between this feature (T010 window bootstrap) and feature-001 (T017) made explicit to avoid duplicate work? [Conflict, tasks.md T010]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the authoritative lockfile specified (`bun.lock` vs `hutch.lock`) for dependency resolution? [Gap, contracts/config.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
